parsed.explanation: The heaviest exposures are traveller-facing and documented as patterns: routine police detention of gender-nonconforming people on pretexts with on-the-spot extortion (multiple sources, 2011–2025), and a 2025 High Court finding of nonconsensual medical procedures and court-ordered 'gender determination' during incarceration — state-imposed custody abuse that remains unremedied, since no implementing legislation is recorded. Sodomy sections 162/165 function as a police lever against visibly gender-nonconforming people and remain in force pending appeal. Social hostility is pervasive enough that interviewees adopt male pseudonyms. Offsetting positives are real but mostly paper: successive court rulings (2018 forced-examination ban, 2023 association, 2025 trans-rights directive, 2026 gender-marker ruling) lack enforcement records; LGBTQ organisations operate under restrictive civic space; one activist's killer received 50 years. No trans-specific offence, no universal facility ban, no killing rate data. Net: recurring state-tolerated targeting plus unremedied custody abuse with only partial, unimplemented recourse.
